news.title: Historic, sometimes troubled, Atlanta cemetery files for bankruptcy
news.summary: A historic Atlanta cemetery previously accused of fraud after about 20 people were found in the wrong graves declared bankruptcy.

news.title: Missing man found dead in DeKalb County, police say
news.summary: A missing man was found shot to death in DeKalb County on Monday afternoon, according to police.

news.title: Suspect wanted in Atlanta shooting that killed young mother turns himself in, authorities say
news.summary: Atlanta Police said 23-year-old Torodd Woods surrendered to the Douglas County Sheriff's Office.

news.title: Death in Stone Mountain area possibly self-inflicted
news.summary: DeKalb County police are investigating after finding a person dead inside a home in unincorporated Stone Mountain.

news.title: Atlanta shooting leaves 1 dead
news.summary: Police said the person was pronounced dead at the scene.

news.title: Joseph E. Boone Blvd shooting: Man found dead at scene
news.summary: A man died Monday evening after being shot along Joseph E. Boone Blvd NW, according to the Atlanta Police Department.
